subject: ddl: add keyspace for distributeDDLOwnerLock (#61588)
summary: Reviewed 51f0587d49 vs first parent: moved keyspace-aware etcd namespacing from `pkg/ddl/owner_mgr.go` into `pkg/store/etcd.go:35` (`NewEtcdCli` now calls `etcd.SetEtcdCliByNamespace(..., keyspace.MakeKeyspaceEtcdNamespace(store.GetCodec()))` when the store codec has a non-empty keyspace prefix). This makes the upgrade distributed lock used by `pkg/session/bootstrap.go:1568` (`/tidb/distributeDDLOwnerLock/` via `storepkg.NewEtcdCli`) and DDL owner election use a keyspace-scoped etcd namespace under API V2, while keeping API V1 behavior effectively unchanged (namespace prefix is empty / not applied). Checked later history up to `upstream/master`: only follow-up touching these files is #62918 adjusting global owner-manager handling for multi-keyspace tests; no evidence of a later fix for a correctness/concurrency regression introduced here.
